The '''Blud'nach Sea''' was an area on the planet [[Byss/Legends|Byss]]. After the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] conquered the planet, the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Predor]] [[Skal'nas]] had his [[Skal'nas Command Center|command center]] situated by the edge of the sea.
